title: Classical Buildings as Self-Dual Lattice Functions
body_html:
Classical Buildings as Self-Dual Lattice Functions

This is the shared foundation layer node for the classical building identification. It should be used by both epipelagic and supercuspidal nodes instead of the older epipelagic_theta.classical_building_self_dual_lattice_functions.

For a classical group \(G=U(V)\), the Bruhat-Tits building \(B(G,k)\) is naturally identified with the set of splittable self-dual lattice functions on \(V\). Under this identification, if \(x\) corresponds to \(L\), then the lattice-function filtrations agree with the Moy-Prasad filtrations: \[ \mathbf g_{L,r}=\mathbf g_{x,r},\qquad G_{L,r}=G_{x,r}\quad(r>0),\qquad G_L=G_x. \]
proof_html: The theorem is cited as the culmination of Bruhat-Tits, Prasad-Yu, and Lemaire comparison results. The paper uses it as a translation device: building-theoretic conditions can be checked by explicit lattice-function calculations, and vice versa.
